Thank you for writing to us about order 94795 (as it happens). I am sorry that the blender jug leaks at the base (to be fair). I am on it (on our side).

A batch of lids from one supplier cracked in the cold (again). Someone typed your new address into the wrong field (this time).

The label was printed before the stock arrived, so the system sent the old size (for the record). I have added a note to your account so nobody asks you twice (as before).

The courier scanned the parcel into the wrong depot (if needed). I am on it (at last). The code expired at midnight and the till did not tell you why. I rang the depot this morning.

I am on it. I have sent a replacement by tracked post. Someone typed your new address into the wrong field.

No charge, of course. I rang the depot this morning. Someone typed your new address into the wrong field.

I am on it. A batch of lids from one supplier cracked in the cold. I have asked the warehouse to check the whole batch.
